title: COMP 3721 · Week 5
subtitle: Analog-to-digital (PCM), digital-to-analog (ASK, FSK, PSK, QAM) and analog-to-analog (AM, FM, PM) conversion, preparing for Quiz 5
description: Lecture 05a: digitization by pulse code modulation, sampling methods, the Nyquist rate, quantization zones and codes on the slide's nine-sample example, bits per sample and bit rate, quantization error and SNR, the bandwidth cost of PCM. Lecture 05b: the carrier, amplitude / frequency / phase shift keying and QAM with their bandwidth boxes, constellation diagrams for every slide example, and AM, FM and PM with the radio allocations. Every worked number from the slides, a live widget for each idea, E05 worked, Mock Quiz 5 and the Week 5 study note.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 5 scope
Quiz 4 covered Lecture 04, so Quiz 5 is expected to cover Lectures 05a and 05b, all of it in this module. The calculations are the Nyquist sampling rate, n_b = log2 L, bit rate = f_s × n_b, B_min = n_b × B_analog, the quantization table (normalize, zone, midpoint, error, code) and a constellation point's amplitude from its I and Q components. Write samples/s for a sampling rate, bps for a bit rate and Hz for a bandwidth. One A4 or letter page of notes, single-sided and preferably hand-written, is allowed; the last lesson is the Week 5 block of that page.
:::
